sloka: कृत अभिषेको गंगायाम् बभूव गत कल्मषः ।भगीरथो राजर्षिः दिव्यम् स्यंदनम् आस्थितः ॥१-४३-२९॥
transliteration: kṛta abhiṣeko gaṁgāyām babhūva gata kalmaṣaḥ ।bhagīratho rājarṣiḥ divyam syaṁdanam āsthitaḥ ॥1-43-29॥

translations.english: People rejoiced at the sight of those shining waters. They were happy to have a dip in Ganga and their fatigue was gone.
